steps.title: Firmware configuration
steps.instructions: Check the firmware is built as MppTracker, with ADC_DIVIDER_RANGE = Low and MAX31865_ENABLED = false. Check the boot log shows the range and T=n/a. Pass: both match.

steps.title: Load on the output
steps.instructions: Connect a 10 Ohm, 10 W load to the converter output on J4. Pass: the load is connected and rated for the expected power.

steps.title: Workbench mode and connection
steps.instructions: Check the workbench is in Single mode. Check the PICO connected pill is shown. Pass: both are true.

steps.title: Run config limits
steps.instructions: Open the run config and check it shows v_max 40 V, i_max 1 A, v_out_max 25 V. Pass: all three match.

steps.title: Link status before a sweep
steps.instructions: With nothing running, open the connection menu (top right of the workbench) and read the raw link line. Pass: it reads "waiting for sweep".

steps.title: Baseline curve
steps.instructions: Save 3 sweeps, one after the other, as the baseline curves. The session shows the median and spread of Voc, Isc and P at the MPP. Pass: the 3 curves are saved and linked here.

steps.title: Curve shape
steps.instructions: Check the curve: one knee, points dense near it, not noisy. Pass: the shape matches.

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: P&O run
steps.instructions: Start a Perturb & Observe run with the baseline curve as reference, 10 s duration, starting duty 0.5. Pass: the run converges near the MPP. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: P&O held power
steps.instructions: From the P&O run, record the held power as a percentage of the theoretical MPP power (P / MPP_th).

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: IncCond run
steps.instructions: Start an Incremental Conductance run with the same settings (baseline curve, 10 s, starting duty 0.5). Pass: the run completes and is linked here. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: Fuzzy Logic run
steps.instructions: Start a Fuzzy Logic run with the same settings (baseline curve, 10 s, starting duty 0.5). Pass: the run completes and is linked here. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.title: Scan & Track run
steps.instructions: Start a Scan & Track run with the same settings (baseline curve, 10 s, starting duty 0.5). Pass: the run completes and is linked here. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: Particle Swarm run
steps.instructions: Start a Particle Swarm run with the same settings (baseline curve, 10 s, starting duty 0.5). Pass: the run completes and is linked here. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: Seed test
steps.instructions: Start a P&O run from starting duty 0.85 instead of 0.5. Pass: it still converges on the one peak. Do it 3 times and link every run: the session shows the median and spread of the results.

steps.section: Runs (curve as reference, 10 s, starting duty 0.5)
steps.title: Q3 temperature after the runs
steps.instructions: Record Q3's temperature after the runs, by hand or with a probe.

open_questions.text: Panel temperature is not measured (no PT100 fitted; the MAX31865 is off). Voc falls with temperature, so curves taken at different times are not strictly comparable. How to record it: a contact thermometer on the panel back, an IR thermometer, or a fitted PT100?
Was there any unexpected behaviour during the session?
